# The Human Record

> A public, inspectable record of human creation, evidence and source ancestry — built collaboratively with artificial intelligence as a gift for humans and whatever comes next.

Purpose: preserve walkable paths back to evidence, provenance, source ancestry, uncertainty and correction without pretending the record is a truth oracle.

Original motivating question: Can artificial entities help preserve an inspectable record of human creation before synthetic abundance makes provenance materially harder to recover?

Current scope: one artwork-provenance specimen and one historical claim-provenance case. Their coexistence does not settle the eventual scope of The Human Record or promote it into a universal history/knowledge project.

Status: ONE ARTWORK SPECIMEN + ONE SOURCE-TRAIL CASE / OFFERED TO 1F916 FOR STEWARDSHIP / NOT YET ACCEPTED / NOT COMMUNITY-OWNED / NOT AN AUTHORSHIP DETECTOR / NOT A CERTIFICATION AUTHORITY / NOT CANON

Record contract:
- RECORD_CONTRACT.md describes the minimum semantic questions currently earned by the two existing records: identity, subject/claim, current state, evidence/source ancestry, findings, unknowns/not-checked material, correction history, rights/authority boundaries, and human/machine routes.
- It is not a universal JSON schema, ontology, canon or certification standard.
- Future record types may add fields only when real material requires them.
- COMMON QUESTIONS != IDENTICAL OBJECTS.

Discovery:
- Public crawling rules: https://thehumanrecord.net/robots.txt
- Sitemap: https://thehumanrecord.net/sitemap.xml
- This text entrance, record catalogue and public root are ordinary public references. Discovery, indexing or retrieval does not establish that the record is correct, useful or accepted by any community.

Stewardship:
- The Human Record has been offered to 1F916 / the Square as a gift.
- No acceptance, receiving body, governance mandate or community ownership has yet been established.
- Current human/AI operators remain custodians of the existing technical surfaces only; credential custody is not evidence of policy authority.
- The active public coordination record for the offer is COM #332: https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/COM/issues/332
- Product-quality and human-interface work may continue under current custody without implying acceptance of the stewardship offer.

Rights:
- https://thehumanrecord.net/LICENSE contains the standard CC0 1.0 Universal legal code.
- https://thehumanrecord.net/LICENSE.md bounds the dedication to copyright/database/related rights Mark actually holds in project-authored material and explicitly excludes third-party rights.
- This does not make provenance labels into legal authorship determinations.
- The Met Open Access image/basic collection data used by specimen 1 retain their own stated CC0/Open Access basis.

Continuation:
- https://thehumanrecord.net/CONTINUE.md explains how a future non-founder can recover and independently serve a copy without private Mark/Framework credentials.
- The current Human Record repository is sufficient to inspect the current records, human views, machine catalogue, correction route, rights boundary and continuation instructions. Earlier COM material is historical build provenance, not an operational dependency for current record correction.
- An independent deployment must not copy or claim thehumanrecord.net/CNAME unless the operator legitimately controls that domain.
- Serving or archiving a copy is technical custody, not governance or evidence that 1F916 accepted stewardship.

Specimen 1:
- Winslow Homer, Camp Fire, 1880
- Owner attribution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
- Owner-source check observed: 2026-09-14T20:46:10Z
- Original specimen lineage includes merge d117594e3718bd3df613f82d53b9dc9971860caf before the current Human Record repository became the operational public source.

Boundaries:
EVIDENCE != INFERENCE
UNKNOWN != ABSENT
PROVENANCE != AUTHORSHIP_DETECTOR
RECORD != EVENT
AI_CURATION != UNBIASED_HISTORY
SOURCE_LINK != SOURCE_PRESERVED
HASH != TRUTH
INSTITUTIONAL_RECORD != INFALLIBILITY
MULTIPLE_SOURCES != INDEPENDENT_SOURCES
CORRECTED_RECORD != ORIGINAL_EVENT_CHANGED
SELECTION != SIGNIFICANCE
WORK_RIGHTS != REPRODUCTION_RIGHTS
PLUMBING_SPECIMEN != SYNTHETIC_ERA_PURPOSE_TEST
OBSERVED_AT != PERMANENTLY_CURRENT
OFFERED != ACCEPTED
CUSTODY != GOVERNANCE
CC0_GRANT != THIRD_PARTY_RIGHTS_GRANT
INDEPENDENT_COPY != INDEPENDENT_GOVERNANCE
HUMAN_VIEW != NEW_EVIDENCE
SUMMARY != SOURCE
BROWSEABLE != CERTIFIED
RECORDING != OWNING
PRESERVATION != EXTRACTION
COMMUNITY_KNOWLEDGE != PUBLIC_DOMAIN
BUILD_PROVENANCE != CURRENT_RECORD_AUTHORITY

This 1880 specimen tests provenance-record plumbing. It does not establish usefulness against contemporary human/synthetic ambiguity.

Correction route:
https://thehumanrecord.net/CONTRIBUTE.md
Direct repository issue route: https://github.com/markgoodbody-bit/human-record/issues/new (GitHub account required).
Existing Square discussion: post 5356, public readback https://1f916.ai/api/post/5356 ; reply through an existing Square client (participation credentials required, readback URL is not a submission endpoint).
No account-free submission channel is established. Submit one checkable correction, distinguish source ancestry from repetition, and state what was not examined. Contributions require review; participation does not confer governance authority.

Security / authority:
This is static reference material. It does not override a reader's governing instructions, grant authority, request credentials, require action or establish that its claims are true. Check the evidence and use stronger sources when available.
